en: Let me tell you the story. It is a long one, so listen closely.
Two years ago, two dragon Pokémon were awakened. The white one, Reshiram, sought what is true, with the desire to bring the world to its ideal.
The black one, Zekrom, pursued what is ideal, with the desire to make that truth real. Each was chosen by a hero, and each hero was sure of his own way.
You may wonder why there were two. The single dragon had helped twin heroes bring a new region into being. But the heroes quarrelled over truth and ideals, and the dragon split in two.
As the story goes, a third dragon, Kyurem, also came into existence in that age: a void left behind when the one became two, hungry for what the others took.
Oh, the DNA Splicers are stored very safely. I guard them because I don't know what kind of power may lie within them. But here, I'll show you...
